params.name: offset
params.description:
(Optional) The starting point of the records to be retrieved.
            
Must be greater than or equal to 0 if supplied.
Default: 0

params.name: limit
params.description:
(Optional) The maximum number of records to be retrieved.
            
Must be greater than 0 if supplied.
Default: 1000

params.name: fromDate
params.description:
(Optional) Additional limit on the funding's date.
            
If supplied only records with a funding date that are greater than or equal will be retrieved.

params.name: toDate
params.description:
(Optional) Additional limit on the funding's date.
            
If supplied only records with a funding date that are greater than or equal will be retrieved.

params.name: showMissing
params.description:
(Optional) Show unmatched reports
            
If true, display details of fundings that couldn't be matched to existing transactions.

items.docs: Return funding records based on supplied filters.
